text:
alex: Heads up — eu-west1 saw a sharp GPU allocation spike around 02:34 UTC, correlating with our synthetic liveness checks.
maya: I saw that too, some instances got primed simultaneously and caused short capacity blips.
alex: logs show a bunch of probes hitting the same GPU pool within a 10s window. stack trace excerpt: `gpu_priming_ms` tag spikes.
sre-bot: alert: probe_fanout_threshold_exceeded { region=\"eu-west1\", probe_type=\"liveness\" } :warning:
jordan: Is this the fanout from our blackbox scheduler? We fan out 5 probes per region by default.
liam: Yeah, default fanout + zero jitter = synchronized warmups. GPUs like to allocate tensors once then keep KV-cache warm, so concurrent cold starts are costly.
maya: Quick mitigation: add per-probe jitter + exponential backoff and shift sampling windows across instances. small change, big impact.
ops-jen: Can we avoid touching production trafficked pools? Prefer synthetic probes to target a dedicated probe pool or set traffic-weighted routing.
alex: Agreed. Two immediate actions: 1) Reduce simultaneous probe fanout in eu-west1 to 1-2. 2) Add randomized 0-30s jitter to probe schedule.
toni: Also propose adding a probe label for `probe_target=probe-pool` so routing can keep them off customer pools.
jordan: For observability: we should add a histogram metric `probe_cold_start_duration_seconds` and break down by region/pool/model_variant so we can alert on priming load, not just error rate.
liam: Prometheus query suggestion: `sum(rate(probe_requests_total{region=~\"eu-.*\"}[5m])) by (instance) / sum(rate(gpu_alloc_count[5m])) by (instance)` — shows probe-per-GPU ratio.
maya: For dashboards: add panel in SLO dashboard for 'probe-induced GPU priming' and a synthetic cost heatmap (cost per synthetic token).
ops-jen: Cost note: synthetic probes are ~0.5% of token bill currently. If we reduce fanout/jitter we should save ~30% of that. still worth optimizing for stability.
sre-bot: deploy: updated probe-scheduler config committed to `infra/probes` — CI green.
alex: Config diff (snippet):
```json
{
  "region": "eu-west1",
  "fanout": 2,
  "jitter_seconds": { "min": 3, "max": 27 },
  "target_pool_label": "probe-pool",
  "sample_rate": 0.005
}
```
maya: Also adding a gating rule: if `probe_cold_start_duration_seconds` > 2s on 3/5 probes, reduce sample_rate by 50% for 30m.
liam: We should also tune alerting: change the `probe_latency_p50/p95` thresholds to exclude the first 2 warmup probes per instance (use histogram_quantile with `le` buckets).
jordan: Putting a note in runbook: if a region shows >15% probe priming ratio, temporarily reroute synthetic traffic and open a paging channel.
ops-jen: I'll schedule a small canary rollout across a single AZ first. want to watch `probe_fanout_per_instance` and `probe_cold_start_duration_seconds`.
alex: Can someone own the dashboard panel? Maya?
maya: Happy to own it. I'll add panels and an explainer in the dashboard describing the cost/stability tradeoffs.
sre-bot: reminder: weekly probe-cost report will include these metrics starting next run.
alex: Thanks all. Let's monitor overnight and revisit tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
